title: hyacinthoides non-scripta
intro: Hyacinthoides non-scripta, commonly known as English bluebells, is a flowering plant species native to Europe and Western Asia. It is prized for its vibrant blue, bell-shaped flowers that bloom in early spring, often in dense, vibrant clusters. The health benefits of English bluebells include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as reducing anxiety and improving sleep quality.
